description: This file defines the CatalogContextSeed class, which includes methods for seeding a database with initial catalog data (brands, types, items) in an e-commerce application. It contains logic for database migration, populating predefined entities, and retrying upon failures.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: A utility class for seeding initial catalog data into the database.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds the catalog data into the database, with retry logic.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Provides a list of predefined catalog brand entities.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Provides a list of predefined catalog type entities.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Provides a list of predefined catalog item entities.
